Question Choices: Select. In the ordered pair $(x, y)$, which number tells you how far to move left or right? ~~the-first-number | the-second-number~~
Hints: The pair is always written (across, up).
Solution: the-first-number -> In (x, y) the x-coordinate comes first and moves you left or right.

Question Choices: Fill: Point A is 4 units right of the origin and 3 units up. Write its coordinates. (__, __)
Hints: Right is a positive x, up is a positive y.
Solution: 4,3 -> 4 right gives x = 4, 3 up gives y = 3.

Question Choices: Fill: Point B is 5 units left of the origin and 2 units down. Write its coordinates. (__, __)
Hints: Left is a negative x, down is a negative y.
Solution: -5,-2 -> 5 left gives x = -5, 2 down gives y = -2.

Question Choices: Select. In which quadrant is the point $(6, -3)$? ~~I | II | III | IV~~
Hints: Positive x, negative y: right of the origin and below it.
Solution: IV -> Quadrant IV holds the points with a positive x and a negative y.

Question Choices: Select. In which quadrant is the point $(-7, -1)$? ~~I | II | III | IV~~
Hints: Both coordinates are negative: left of the origin and below it.
Solution: III -> Quadrant III holds the points where x and y are both negative.

Question Choices: Select. Where is the point $(0, -4)$? ~~on-the-x-axis | on-the-y-axis | in-Quadrant-III | in-Quadrant-IV~~
Hints: A point with x = 0 has not moved left or right at all.
Solution: on-the-y-axis -> x = 0 means the point sits on the y-axis, 4 units below the origin. Points on an axis are in no quadrant.

Question Choices: Fill: Point P is at $(3, 5)$. It is reflected over the x-axis. Write the coordinates of the new point. (__, __)
Hints: Reflecting over the x-axis flips the point above/below, so only y changes sign.
Solution: 3,-5 -> Over the x-axis the x-coordinate stays and the y-coordinate changes sign: (3, 5) becomes (3, -5).

Question Choices: Fill: Point Q is at $(-2, 6)$. It is reflected over the y-axis. Write the coordinates of the new point. (__, __)
Hints: Reflecting over the y-axis flips the point left/right, so only x changes sign.
Solution: 2,6 -> Over the y-axis the y-coordinate stays and the x-coordinate changes sign: (-2, 6) becomes (2, 6).

Question Choices: Select. A point has a negative x-coordinate and a positive y-coordinate. Which quadrant is it in? ~~I | II | III | IV~~
Hints: Left of the origin, above it.
Solution: II -> Left of the origin (negative x) and above it (positive y) is Quadrant II.

Question Choices: Fill: Start at the point $(2, 3)$. Move 6 units left and 4 units down. Write the coordinates you land on. (__, __)
Hints: Left subtracts from x, down subtracts from y.
Solution: -4,-1 -> x: 2 - 6 = -4. y: 3 - 4 = -1. The point lands in Quadrant III.
